summary: This topic outlines the process of creating a daily timetable for a class, including defining lecture numbers, start and end times, assigning subjects, and mapping teachers. It also covers how to incorporate breaks into the schedule.
steps: Select the 'Class' for which the timetable is being created.
Optionally, select the 'Subject' from the dropdown list (subjects must be mapped to the class).
Optionally, select the 'Employee' (teacher) from the list (teachers must be mapped as subject teachers for that class/subject).
To define a break, click on the schedule entry and toggle the 'Break' option on.
Click 'Push' to add the subject/teacher to the schedule for that slot.
Repeat for all lectures and breaks for the day.
Click 'Save Schedule' after defining all entries for the day.
Repeat the process for other days of the week (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, etc.).
business_rules: Start and end times define the duration of each period.
Teachers assigned to lecture slots must be mapped as subject teachers for the respective subject and class.
Breaks can be defined within the schedule by toggling the 'Break' option.
important_notes: The system often auto-suggests the start time for the next lecture based on the previous one's end time.
It is possible to schedule multiple subjects concurrently if needed (e.g., for different sections or activities).
